checks.detail: The native producer requires the original 22-file map and completed manifest, archived configurations and run references; strict CPU float32 state_dict loading uses the unchanged native model and verifies 29,856 parameters plus default zero nonpersistent grounding buffers.

All five 64-row T16 compatibility forwards are saved before a durable gates_summary and before any extended trajectory. The same forwards supply the four initial states. Logit tolerance is atol 1e-4 plus rtol 1e-5 against saved logits, with all64 predictions exact.

Compatibility failure preserves all five gates, produces verified status/exit0 with no seeds directory, and is accepted by the controller/binder without being called compatible. Unexpected invariant/resource/source failures remain failed.

Positive gate permits exactly five seeds, four fixed related validation queries and two branches:40 trajectories, each retaining time0 through at most256. The native report has five policy/integrity checks.

The direction is coordinate checkerboard parity over3840 components. Nominal amplitude is1e-4*max(1,RMS(initial)); represented perturbation is float32, actual difference/denominator float64. A single post-update1 injection installs the initial state; future source is held and no repeated state reseeding occurs.

The first nonfinite state or maxabs>1e12 is retained with prior observations. Such per-trajectory censoring is a scientific outcome. Unobserved slots remain explicitly padded, and pairs use only shared observed finite times.

The final protocol now agrees with the producer: raw state/readout masks are separate; undefined readout prediction=-1 and NLL=NaN do not mean unobserved state. Final identical nonfinite readouts use equal_nan only for the logits comparison.

Each gate NPZ has39 named arrays and each extended seed NPZ59. Each includes all12 named parameter/buffer tensors before and after under weight__/weight_after__, plus RNG states. JSON descriptors bind path,bytes,SHA256 and array shape/dtype.

The binder independently loads five original checkpoints with weights_only=True without model imports or inference; compares10 literal parameter shapes/configs/values and two zero buffers to every before/after gate/conditional seed snapshot. Native JSON/NPZ inventory is12 files if negative or22 if positive.

Recovery120s/native240s/binding60s/audit120s execute serially with private child processes under the outer owned process group. Each component requires zero exit and verified status; binding/audit require positive checks and zero issues. Admission uses a shared600s stage deadline and source hashes are checked before/after.

The protocol distinguishes four queries of one exposed scene from independent groups, records Python/thread migration and absence of historical hidden-state arrays, and gives planned raw state payloads rather than measured compressed sizes.

The recipe/protocol make no training, useful-memory, fresh-generalization, global-Lipschitz, operator-norm, Lyapunov-exponent or infinite-time assertion. Checkpoint/readout compatibility is not proof of historical hidden-state equality.

resolved_findings.detail: Single paragraph now distinguishes observed finite state from finite logits and conditional NLL/prediction.

preserved_native_preimage.delta_to_final: Added readout/metric tolerance recipe fields and NaN-aware exact final-logit snapshot comparison; no update rule or trajectory selection change.

limitations: Static source review only: no Python, compilation, Torch execution, model replay, new tests or scientific result inspection.
This receipt does not certify future execution, resource compliance, compatibility success or checkpoint outcomes; future immutable raw receipts and independent array audit are required.

The independent NumPy learned-dynamics auditor and recovery/worker/workflow code are not covered by this four-file review; their contracts are coordinated but their own implementation review is separate.
Checkpoint binding confirms saved tensors against historical checkpoints; it does not independently rerun the complete recurrent dynamics or provide external-laboratory replication.
One JS-only attempt to extract RECIPE failed on Python list(SEEDS); the in-memory extraction was corrected. No producer or scientific artifact was executed or altered by that metadata operation.
